data.title: Speeding fine (Bußgeldbescheid) – €132.00
data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle (fines office) of Kreis Beispielborken issued a fine notice against Johanna Beispielacker for driving 23 km/h over the 100 km/h limit outside built-up areas on 5 October 2026, imposing a total of €132.00 (fine, fee and delivery costs) plus 1 point on the Fahreignungsregister.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for a speeding offence. You may decide whether to accept it or to object (Einspruch) within the period shown by the app, counted from the delivery date noted on the enclosed delivery certificate. If you do not object, the notice becomes final and you must then pay the total amount within the stated period after that. Consider getting legal advice if you want to contest the measurement or the fine amount. If you do nothing and also don't pay once it is final, further enforcement steps can follow.

items.title: File an objection (Einspruch) against the fine
items.action: Decide whether to object in writing or in person (zur Niederschrift) at the Bußgeldstelle before the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed within the period, the fine becomes final (rechtskräftig) and enforceable.
items.quote: Binnen zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung dieses Bescheids kann Einspruch eingelegt werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielborken – Bußgeldstelle.

items.title: Pay the fine once it becomes final
items.action: Wait until the notice becomes legally final (no objection filed or the objection period has ended), then transfer the total amount within the period shown after that point.
items.consequence: Paying before the notice is final is not requested; late payment after it becomes final can lead to further collection measures.
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Gesamtbetrag erst nach Rechtskraft, und zwar innerhalb von zwei Wochen.
